name: Shots
description: Nine different shots of your scene from one photo.

steps.label: Shoot nine shots
steps.prompt: Re-shoot this exact scene as {{each}}. Keep the same people, objects, clothing, setting, colors, light and style. Only the camera position and framing change.
each: a wide establishing shot that shows the whole setting around the subject
a full shot that frames the subject from head to toe
a medium shot from the waist up
a medium close-up from the chest up
a close-up of the face or the main detail
an extreme close-up of one small telling detail
an over-the-shoulder shot looking past the subject
a low-angle shot looking up at the subject
a high-angle shot looking down from above
steps.needs: an image editing model, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

name: Angles
description: See your subject from new camera angles.

steps.label: Turn the camera
steps.prompt: Show exactly the same subject from a new camera angle: {{each}}. Keep its identity, shape, proportions, materials, colors and the light the same. Only the camera position changes.
steps.needs: an image editing model, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

name: Zooms
description: Close, medium and wide versions of one photo.

steps.label: Reframe
steps.prompt: Reframe this exact scene as {{each}}. Keep every person, object, material, color and the light the same. Where the new frame is wider than the photo, continue the scene naturally beyond its edges.
each: a close-up that fills the frame with the main subject
a medium shot that shows the subject and some of its surroundings
a wide shot that pulls far back to show the whole place around the subject
steps.needs: an image editing model, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

name: Relight
description: Change where the light comes from and its mood.

fields.label: Describe the light
fields.help: Optional. For example: warm window light, soft shadows.

steps.label: Relight
steps.prompt: Relight this photo with {{#light}}{{light}}, {{/light}}{{mood}}, the main light coming from the {{direction}}. Keep the subject, composition and every detail the same.
steps.needs: a relight model such as IC-Light on fal, or an image editing model such as Nano Banana, GPT Image or FLUX Klein Edit

name: Face swap
description: Put the face from one photo on the person in another.

steps.label: Swap the face
steps.prompt: The first image is the target photo and the second image shows a face. Give the person in the target photo the face from the second image, with the same facial features, skin tone and identity. Keep the target photo's pose, head angle, expression, hair, body, clothing, light, background and framing as they are, so it looks like a real photo.
steps.needs: an image editing model that takes two or more images, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

name: Product placement
description: Place your product into a scene photo or a scene you describe.

fields.label: Scene description
fields.help: Describe the scene, or add a scene photo.

steps.label: Place the product
steps.prompt: Place the exact product from the first image {{#scene}}into the scene from the second image{{/scene}}{{^scene}}into a new photo{{/scene}}{{#where}}: {{where}}{{/where}}. Keep the product's shape, proportions, colors, materials, label and logo unchanged. Match the light, shadows, reflections and perspective so it looks photographed there.
steps.needs: an image editing model that takes two or more images, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

name: Color grade
description: Give a photo a film look, teal and orange or bleach bypass.

steps.label: Grade
steps.prompt: Color grade this photo and keep every person, object, detail and the composition exactly the same. Change only color, contrast and tone
steps.needs: an image editing model, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

name: Upscale
description: Enlarge a photo with added detail for print or 4K screens.

steps.label: Upscale
steps.needs: an upscaler, such as Topaz, Clarity or SeedVR on fal, or ESRGAN in ComfyUI

name: UGC ad
description: A handheld phone video of a person showing your product.

fields.label: What they say
fields.help: One or two short sentences, in a real customer's words.

steps.label: Snap the selfie
steps.prompt: A casual vertical smartphone selfie photo of {{#presenter}}the same person as in the presenter photos{{/presenter}}{{^presenter}}a friendly everyday person{{/presenter}} in {{setting}}, holding the exact product from the product photo up near the face. Natural daylight, real skin texture, unposed handheld framing, true colors. Keep the product's shape, label and colors exactly.
steps.needs: an image editing model, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

steps.label: Film the ad
steps.prompt: The person talks to the phone camera with natural gestures and shows the product. They say: "{{line}}". Handheld selfie video with a little natural camera shake.
steps.needs: an image-to-video model, such as Kling, LTX or Wan on fal, Sora with an OpenAI key, or LTX or Wan in ComfyUI

name: Hook variants
description: Several openings for the same video, one clip each.

fields.label: Openings
fields.help: One opening per line: what happens on screen in the first seconds.

steps.label: Film each opening
steps.prompt: {{each}}, the fast and surprising opening of a short social video
steps.needs: an image-to-video model, such as Kling, LTX or Wan on fal, Sora with an OpenAI key, or LTX or Wan in ComfyUI

name: Explainer
description: Turn a list of scenes into stills, then into clips.

fields.label: Scenes
fields.help: One scene per line, in order. Each line becomes a still and a clip.

steps.label: Draw each scene
steps.prompt: {{each}}, one clear scene from an explainer video, simple composition with one main subject
steps.needs: a text-to-image model, such as Nano Banana or Seedream on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein in ComfyUI

steps.label: Animate each scene
steps.prompt: {{each}}, gentle camera move, smooth natural motion
steps.needs: an image-to-video model, such as Kling, LTX or Wan on fal, Sora with an OpenAI key, or LTX or Wan in ComfyUI

name: Cinema shot
description: Direct a shot like on a film set: Pictesa composes the still with your lens and light, then animates it with your camera move.

fields.label: Scene
fields.help: Who or what is in frame, where, and what happens.

steps.label: Compose the still
steps.prompt: {{scene}}, cinematic film still, {{lens}} lens, {{light}}, shallow depth of field, natural film grain
steps.needs: a text-to-image model, such as Nano Banana or Seedream on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein in ComfyUI

steps.label: Shoot the move
steps.needs: an image-to-video model, such as Kling, LTX or Wan on fal, Sora with an OpenAI key, or LTX or Wan in ComfyUI

name: Character shot
description: Put your own character or product into a directed shot. Your reference keeps the look consistent; the camera move brings it to life.

steps.label: Place the character
steps.prompt: The same person or object from the reference images, {{scene}}, cinematic film still, {{lens}} lens, {{light}}, keep the face, clothing and proportions identical
steps.needs: an image editing model, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

steps.label: Shoot the move
steps.needs: an image-to-video model, such as Kling, LTX or Wan on fal, Sora with an OpenAI key, or LTX or Wan in ComfyUI

name: Product hero
description: Turn a plain product photo into a studio hero shot, then a slow orbit for ads.

steps.label: Studio still
steps.prompt: Professional product photograph of the exact product from the reference, on a {{setting}}, softbox lighting, crisp detail, unchanged shape, colors and logo
steps.needs: an image editing model, such as Nano Banana or GPT Image on fal, Gemini or OpenAI with your own key, or FLUX Klein Edit in ComfyUI

steps.label: Orbit
steps.prompt: the product stays still and unchanged while the camera moves
steps.needs: an image-to-video model, such as Kling, LTX or Wan on fal, Sora with an OpenAI key, or LTX or Wan in ComfyUI

name: Animate a photo
description: Bring any photo to life with a camera move and a line about what should happen.

fields.label: What happens
fields.help: Optional. For example: the curtains move in the wind.

steps.label: Animate
steps.needs: an image-to-video model, such as Kling, LTX or Wan on fal, Sora with an OpenAI key, or LTX or Wan in ComfyUI
